title: Repeat Non-Formulary Rejections — Claims Desk Questions and Answers
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit, transition fills.** Days are added to a newly enrolled member's transition fill when the same non-formulary drug has been turned away at the counter more than once.

**Rule.** The repeat rejection days are four (4) where the drug was turned away as non-formulary three or more times in the last month, two (2) where it was turned away exactly twice, and nothing otherwise.

### Questions and answers

*Which drug is counted?* The drug named on the latest counter rejection for non-formulary status on the member's pharmacy coverage.

*Which rejections count?* Counter rejections of that drug for non-formulary status with a fill date in the last month, the latest rejection included.

*Where do the days go?* They are added to the transition fill days.

*Do rejections for other reasons count?* No. Only rejections for non-formulary status count.

### Table

| Non-formulary rejections of the drug, last month | Repeat rejection days |
|---|---|
| Three or more | 4 |
| Exactly two | 2 |
| One | Nothing |
